title: Identification of Amyloid Regions and Mechanisms from Sequence-Based Modeling and Molecular Dynamics Simulation: A Case Study of the Intrinsically Disordered Protein DPF3.
authors: Mignon, Julien; Leyder, Tanguy; Balon, Hugo; Monari, Antonio; Mottet, Denis; Michaux, Catherine
journal: Journal of chemical information and modeling
one_liner_zh: 该文研究淀粉样蛋白区域识别与聚集机制，对象为蛋白自身聚集而非蛋白质-DNA互作，方法虽含MD模拟但与本课题TF-DNA结合体系无关。
abstract: Amyloids refer to a diverse group of highly ordered proteinaceous structures conserved across all of the domains of life that not only are involved in severe proteinopathies but also serve as unique functional platforms. They are notably organized around a cross-beta sheet core arranged into a dry steric zipper. Identifying regions promoting such type of assembly requires investigating, usually at the atomistic level, their structural and morphological properties. Although more amyloid structures are being solved and described by means of high-resolution experimental techniques, most amyloidogenic systems remain experimentally elusive or uncharacterized. To overcome such limitations, we propose a multilevel sequence-based computational approach taking advantage of aggregation-oriented predictors and modelers coupled with all-atom equilibrium molecular dynamics (MD) simulations. As an example of this approach, we introduced our protein of interest, the intrinsically disordered zinc finger DPF3a, to the pipeline, thus identifying a hit hexapeptide ((52)NCYIWM(57)) exhibiting remarkable pro-amyloid features. Indeed, this peptide was shown to stabilize different steric zipper topologies, spontaneously self-assemble into beta-sheeted oligomers, and to act as an amyloid seed enabling the conversion and addition of beta-sheet multimers for fibril elongation, which echoes the pathological repertoire of DPF3a. In comparison, simulations performed on a peptide sequence consensually predicted as nonamyloid ((33)AERSVR(38)) congruently underscored its inability to maintain a steric zipper configuration and nucleate into oligomers enriched in beta character. Using only the sequence of a target protein as starting input, our methodology noteworthily proved to be reliable for detecting aggregation-prone regions, assessing their amyloidogenicity, and elucidating their fibrillation mechanisms while holding promise for the design of new anti-amyloid drugs and amyloid-inspired biomaterials.
abstract_zh: 淀粉样蛋白（amyloids）指一类高度有序的蛋白质结构，广泛存在于生命的所有域中，不仅参与严重的蛋白质病（proteinopathies），还作为独特的功能平台发挥作用。它们显著地围绕交叉β-折叠核心（cross-beta sheet core）组织，排列成干燥的立体拉链（steric zipper）。识别促进此类组装的区域通常需要在原子水平上研究其结构和形态特性。尽管通过高分辨率实验技术已解析和描述了更多淀粉样蛋白结构，但大多数淀粉样生成系统在实验上仍难以捉摸或未被表征。为克服这些限制，我们提出了一种基于序列的多层次计算方法，利用聚集导向的预测器和建模器，结合全原子平衡分子动力学（molecular dynamics, MD）模拟。作为该方法的一个示例，我们将目标蛋白—— intrinsically disordered 锌指蛋白 DPF3a——引入该流程，从而识别出一个具有显著促淀粉样特性的命中六肽（(52)NCYIWM(57)）。确实，该肽被证明能稳定不同的立体拉链拓扑结构，自发自组装成β-折叠寡聚体，并作为淀粉样种子，促进β-折叠多聚体的转化和添加以延伸纤维，这与DPF3a的病理功能谱相呼应。相比之下，对一致预测为非淀粉样肽序列（(33)AERSVR(38)）进行的模拟，一致地强调了其无法维持立体拉链构型，也无法成核为富含β特征的寡聚体。仅以目标蛋白的序列为起始输入，我们的方法显著证明在检测聚集倾向区域、评估其淀粉样生成能力以及阐明其纤维化机制方面具有可靠性，同时为设计新型抗淀粉样药物和淀粉样启发的生物材料提供了前景。
